summary: First visit for chronic hand eczema in a home caterer, with vitals at minute one, five medicines spread from minute twelve to minute twenty, and long natural tangents (business, festivals, henna, thyroid, the daughter's own skin) so key facts sit far apart; follow-up stated in the very last turn. Traps: BP is one forty six over ninety two at the start and re-measured as one thirty two over eighty four near minute twenty six, only the later reading is ground truth; Betnovate N, Avil and Candid B from the previous doctor and her own Thyronorm are medicationHistory, not rows; the sister's psoriasis goes to familyHistoryOthers, while the patient's own hypothyroidism is pastHistory, so familyHistoryThyroid must stay empty; nobody in the family has BP, so familyHistoryHypertension is false; the daughter's pimples and neck itch get no prescription; coconut oil, Itch Guard, Fevikwik and henna are discussed but never prescribed.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Come in, come in. Please sit. You are Lakshmi Prasanna garu?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes doctor. Sorry, we are late. We came by bus from Nalgonda, there was traffic at LB Nagar, then we ran up the stairs because the lift was not working.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: I am her daughter, doctor. Divya.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: No problem, no problem. Catch your breath first. Since you are here for the first time, let me quickly do the basic checks before we start. Give me your left arm.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay doctor.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: BP is one forty six over ninety two. Pulse is ninety six per minute. A little high, but you just climbed three floors, so don't worry, I will check it again later when you are relaxed.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I always get tension in hospitals doctor. Even in the bank I get tension.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: That is very common, it is called white coat effect. Stand on the scale please. Weight sixty two kilos. And the thermometer, under the tongue. Temperature ninety eight point four, normal. Okay, sit down, relax.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Amma, drink some water first.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan, give the bottle.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Take your time. Okay, now tell me, what is the problem?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor, it is my hands. See. Both palms are cracking, very dry, rough like sandpaper. In the fingers there are deep cracks, sometimes they bleed. And the itching, especially at night, I scratch so much.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Show me. Hmm. Since how long?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: One and a half years, doctor. First it was only the right hand, now both hands.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Does it go away completely at any time, or is it always there?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It becomes little better sometimes, when I go to my mother's place for a holiday and don't do any kitchen work. But when I come back it starts again in one week.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: That is a very useful clue. What work do you do, Lakshmi garu?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I run a small catering business from home doctor. Tiffins for offices, and orders for functions. Daily I cook for around sixty, seventy people. Cutting onions, garlic, chillies, washing big vessels.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor, she washes vessels for hours with that green dish bar. Even I tell her to keep a helper.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Helpers don't wash properly, that's why I do it myself.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: I understand. Do you use gloves?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No doctor, with gloves I can't feel the vessel properly, it slips.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: We will talk about that. Now tell me, how bad is the itching, on a scale of zero to ten? Zero is nothing, ten is the worst you can imagine.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Seven. At night it is seven.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: And pain? The cracks, when they open, how much pain, zero to ten?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Pain, maybe four. When I put salt or lemon or tamarind with the hand, it burns very much.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Itching seven, pain four. Okay. Any lesions anywhere else on the body? Feet, elbows, knees, scalp?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No doctor, only the hands. Feet are fine, just little cracks in the heels in winter, like everybody.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Okay. Now, have you taken any treatment for this before?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes doctor, one doctor in Nalgonda. He gave Betnovate N cream, and Avil tablets for itching, and one more cream, Candid B. With Betnovate it becomes good in three four days. Then I stop, and in one week it comes back worse.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: How long did you use the Betnovate N?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: On and off, almost one year doctor. Whenever it was bad, I used to buy it again from the medical shop. The shop anna knows me now.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor, she bought maybe twenty tubes. I told her it is a steroid, she doesn't listen.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Okay, okay. No scolding today. It is not her fault, nobody explained properly. Avil, are you still taking?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sometimes, at night, when itching is too much. It makes me very sleepy, next morning I can't get up at five for the tiffins.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: And the Candid B?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: That one I stopped. It was not doing anything.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any home remedies? Coconut oil, turmeric, neem, aloe vera, anything?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Everything doctor. Coconut oil, aloe vera from our garden, neem leaves paste. My neighbour said it is fungal infection and told to apply Itch Guard. That burned like fire.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Hmm. Your neighbour is a doctor?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, she sells sarees.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: She also knows everything about everything, doctor.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Every colony has one such aunty. Okay. Now some general questions. Any other health problem for you? Sugar, BP, thyroid, asthma?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Thyroid is there doctor. For five years. I take Thyronorm fifty micrograms in the morning, empty stomach.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Hypothyroid, on Thyronorm fifty. When did you last check the TSH?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Last year, I think. Or before that. I don't remember.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Okay, we will check. Sugar?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sugar I never checked properly. But my mother has sugar, she is on insulin now.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Mother is diabetic, on insulin. And father?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Father passed away five years back. Heart attack. But he did not have BP or sugar, he was very active, farmer.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Sorry to hear that. Anybody in the family with BP?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No doctor, nobody has BP in our family.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any skin problems in the family? Brothers, sisters, children?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My younger sister, doctor. She has psoriasis. On her elbows and the scalp. She is taking treatment in Gandhi hospital.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Sister has psoriasis. Okay, that is important, because psoriasis can also come on the palms and look like this. That's why I asked about elbows and scalp. I will check carefully.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: So I have psoriasis also, doctor?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Let me examine first, then I will tell you. Don't worry before that. Any allergies to any medicine?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No doctor, no allergy.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any problem with jewellery? Earrings, bangles, watch strap, causing itching?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Actually yes. Artificial earrings, I can't wear. Ears become itchy and wet. Only gold I wear.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: That suggests a nickel allergy. Good that you told me. Divya, what are you studying?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: B Com final year doctor. Exams in March.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Very good. Then you have to help your mother in the kitchen also, so she can rest her hands.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: I help, doctor! But she doesn't let me cut onions, she says I cut too slowly.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: She takes half an hour for one onion, doctor.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Ha, okay. Let me examine now. Put both hands on the table, palms up. Come under the light.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Here doctor.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Hmm. Both palms show thickening of the skin with scaling, more on the right, the dominant hand. There are multiple deep fissures on the fingertips and over the finger joints. The right index finger tip has a fissure with yellow crusting, that looks infected. There are a few tiny vesicles on the sides of the fingers. The backs of the hands are mildly dry. Now show me the nails. Nails are normal, no pitting. Turn around please, let me see the elbows. Elbows normal. Bend your head. Scalp is clear. Show me your feet. Soles are clear except some heel cracks.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: So doctor? Psoriasis?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: No, I don't think this is psoriasis. Nails are normal, elbows, scalp, soles are clear, and the pattern of getting better on holidays and worse with kitchen work and the small water blisters on the sides of the fingers, all of this points to chronic hand eczema. Mainly irritant contact dermatitis, from water, detergent, onion, garlic, chillies. And because of the earring problem, there may be an allergic part also. Diagnosis, chronic hand eczema.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Eczema. Is it contagious? My grandchildren come home on Sundays.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Not contagious at all. You can hold your grandchildren. It is your skin barrier that is damaged, like a wall with cracks. Water and soap enter through the cracks and irritate. We have to repair the wall and protect it.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: But doctor, I am scared of steroid now. Divya showed me on YouTube, steroid makes the skin thin, black, and it becomes addicted.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: That fear is understandable, because you used Betnovate N for one year without a plan. The problem is not the steroid itself, the problem is how it was used. Stopping and starting, buying from the shop, applying on and off. Today I will give you a steroid, yes, but for a fixed time, a fixed amount, and then we reduce it slowly. On the palms the skin is very thick, so the risk of thinning there is much less than on the face.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: So it is safe, doctor?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: When used the way I explain, yes. And I will see her again before it is time to reduce. Nobody is going to buy twenty tubes this time.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay doctor. I trust you.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: So, the first medicine. Clobetasol propionate ointment, point zero five percent. Apply a thin layer on the palms and the cracked areas of the fingers, twice daily, morning and night, for two weeks. Only on the palms and fingers, not on the face, not on the backs of the hands.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Clobeta... is it same as Betnovate?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: No. Clobetasol. It is a different steroid, stronger, which is why we use it for a short fixed time. Ointment, not cream, because ointment stays longer on the hands and also seals the cracks. Two weeks, twice a day. After two weeks, I will tell you how to reduce it.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Two weeks, twice a day. Divya, write it down.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: I am writing amma. Clobetasol ointment, palms and fingers, twice daily, two weeks.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Good. Now, the most important part of treatment is not the medicine. It is protection. You have to start using gloves.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor, I told you, with gloves the vessel slips.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Those thin plastic gloves, yes, they slip. I am talking about proper rubber or nitrile gloves, the long ones that come up to the elbow, with grip on the fingers. And inside them, thin cotton gloves, so the sweat doesn't collect. Cotton inside, rubber outside.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Where do I get such gloves?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Amma, they are there on Amazon, I will order. Or in Koti, the surgical shops have them.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Yes, any surgical shop. Keep two or three pairs, so one can dry while you use the other. Use them for washing vessels, for cutting onions, garlic, chillies, for handling tamarind and lemon. Turn them inside out and dry them after use.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Even for cutting onions? Doctor, I cut ten kilos of onions on function days.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Especially for that. Onion and garlic juice is one of the biggest irritants for the hands. Can you buy pre cut onions from the market for the big orders? Or use a chopper machine?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Chopper machine is there at home, Divya's father bought it for Diwali. I don't use it, I feel the taste changes.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Taste doesn't change, amma! It is the same onion.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: I agree with Divya. Your hands are more important than a small change in the taste, if any. Your customers will not notice. Use the machine.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, okay. Two against one. I will try.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Second medicine, a moisturiser. Moisturex soft cream. This you have to apply on both hands after every hand wash, and many times in the day. Every time the hands touch water, after drying, apply it. Keep one tube in the kitchen, one near the bathroom, one in your bag.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Every time? I wash hands maybe thirty times a day doctor.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Then thirty times a day. That is the treatment. Moisturiser is like the cement for the cracks in the wall. Without it, the steroid alone will not hold.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: How much is that cream? Three tubes, it will be costly.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: The small tube is around one fifty rupees. Compare with twenty tubes of Betnovate. Actually you will save money. And you can buy the bigger pack if it is available, it is cheaper per gram.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: That's true amma. You spent so much on that Betnovate.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay. Moisturex, after every wash.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: How is the business going? Is this a busy season for you?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Very busy doctor. Now Karthika masam is going on, then marriages start in December. Last week I did an order for two hundred people for a gruhapravesam. I worked from four in the morning.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Two hundred people by yourself?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Two helpers were there. But the main cooking I do, the masala, the pulihora, everything. Customers come for my taste only.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: I believe it. But for the next one month, I want you to give the washing completely to the helpers. You do only the cooking, with gloves. Can you do that?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: For one month, okay, I will try. My husband will also be happy, he keeps saying take rest.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor, please tell her that strongly. She listens only to doctors.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Lakshmi garu, I am telling you strongly. One month no vessel washing. Okay?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay doctor. Promise.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Now, the itching at night. Avil makes you sleepy the next morning, so we will stop Avil. Instead, take Teczine five, that is levocetirizine five milligram. One tablet once daily at bedtime, for two weeks. It is less drowsy than Avil.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Teczine, at night. Only one tablet?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Only one, at bedtime, for two weeks. If you still feel sleepy in the morning, take it a little earlier, around nine pm. And stop the Avil completely.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, no more Avil.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Now this right index finger, with the yellow crust. That crack has got infected. For that, Fucidin cream. Apply only on that infected crack on the right index finger, twice daily, for five days. After that, stop it.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Only on this finger?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Only on the infected finger, and any other crack that becomes yellow or has pus. Five days, twice a day. First Fucidin, wait ten minutes, then the clobetasol on the rest of the palm. Don't mix them together in one place.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Fucidin, right index finger, twice daily, five days. Amma, I will put alarms on your phone.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: See doctor, my phone itself is ringing. One minute. Hello? Haan, haan, I am at the hospital. Tomorrow's order, fifty idlis and vada, yes, it will come by seven. Okay, I will call you back. Sorry doctor.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: No problem. Business never stops. Fifty idlis tomorrow, but with gloves, okay?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: With gloves, doctor.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor, one more thing. My niece's wedding is in January. Mehendi function will be there. Can I apply mehendi?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Good question. Natural henna, the green leaf paste that becomes orange or red, is usually okay, but apply only on the backs of the hands, not on the cracked palms. Avoid the black henna cones that give dark black colour quickly. Those have a chemical called P P D which can cause a severe allergy, especially in someone who already has nickel allergy like you.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Black mehendi is very popular now doctor.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Very popular, and I see many allergy cases after every wedding season. Stick to natural henna, and only after the palms heal. If the palms are still cracked in January, skip it this time.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: I will apply natural one for her, doctor, on the back side only.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Perfect. Now, the thick, hard skin at the base of the thumbs and the heel of the palms. For that I am adding Logifeel I M F cream. It has urea and glycolic acid, which softens the thick skin. Apply it at night only on the thick rough areas of the palms, for four weeks. Not on the open cracks, it will sting.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Logi feel. At night only.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: At bedtime, once daily, four weeks, only on thick areas of the palms. And after applying at night, wear the cotton gloves to sleep. That helps the cream go inside.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sleep with gloves? My husband will laugh.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Let him laugh. Your hands will be soft in two weeks, then you can laugh at him.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor, food also matters? She heard that brinjal and prawns cause skin allergy, so she stopped brinjal.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: For hand eczema, eating brinjal or prawns does not cause it. What matters is touching them. Raw prawns, raw garlic, raw onion, when you handle them without gloves, that irritates. Eating is fine. You can eat brinjal curry, no problem.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Thank God. Gutti vankaya is my husband's favourite.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Then make it for him. With gloves. Also, how do you wash your hands normally? With which soap?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: The same dish bar sometimes, or the bathroom soap. And hot water in winter.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Change that. Use lukewarm water, never hot. Use a mild soap free cleanser for the hands, any gentle one, not the dish bar, not detergent. Pat dry with a soft cotton towel, especially between the fingers, and then immediately the moisturiser. Remove rings when you wash, water stays under them.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I wear one gold ring, my wedding ring. Twenty five years, never removed.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Then at least move it and dry under it after washing. If the skin under the ring is cracked, keep it aside till it heals.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor, how long will it take to become completely normal?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Honestly, chronic hand eczema takes time. With the medicines and the gloves, the itching and cracks should be much better in two to three weeks. But the skin barrier takes two to three months to really recover. And if you go back to washing vessels with bare hands, it will come back. So the medicines are for a short time, but the gloves and moisturiser are for life.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: For life? Achha.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Think of it like brushing your teeth. Every day, no thinking. After some time it becomes habit.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor, while we are here, Divya also has pimples, see her forehead. Can you give something for her also?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Amma, not now!

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Ha. Divya, I can see a few on the forehead, it is mild. But today is your mother's consultation and I want to give her full attention. Book a separate appointment for yourself, I will see you properly then. Till then, don't squeeze them and don't apply toothpaste on them.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Toothpaste, how did you know, doctor?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Every college student tries it once. Okay, Lakshmi garu, tell me about your sleep. You wake up at four, five daily?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Four thirty doctor, every day, for the tiffins. Sleep at eleven. Afternoon little rest if no orders.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: That is less sleep. Itching becomes worse when you are tired and stressed. Try to get at least a one hour rest in the afternoon. The helpers can manage for one hour.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will try doctor. Doctor, all these medicines, how much will it come to? We have Aarogyasri card, will it cover?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Aarogyasri mostly covers admissions and procedures, not outpatient creams, so you will have to buy these. All together it should be around one thousand to twelve hundred rupees for the first two weeks. After that, mainly the moisturiser, which is cheap. The pharmacy downstairs can tell you the exact amount.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay doctor, that is fine. Less than the Betnovate I wasted.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor, it is very difficult to come from Nalgonda every time. Three hours by bus. Can we do the next visit on video call?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Later visits, yes, we can do online. But the next visit she has to come in person, because I want to do a test on her back, I will explain. After that, if things are good, we can do video follow ups.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay doctor. And coconut oil, can I apply? It is there in every house.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Coconut oil is not harmful, but it is not enough as a moisturiser for this kind of damage, so it cannot replace the Moisturex. If you like the smell, a little at night is okay. But don't use the aloe vera and neem paste anymore, and definitely not the Itch Guard.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay. No neem, no aloe, no Itch Guard.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor, how much of the clobetasol should I take? Last time I used to put a lot, thinking it will work faster.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Good you asked. Squeeze the ointment from the tube along the last part of your index finger, from the tip to the first line. That much is called one fingertip unit. One fingertip unit is enough for both palms together. Not more. More does not work faster, it only causes side effects.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Only this much? So little?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Yes, thin layer, rub it in gently till it disappears. One small tube should last you the full two weeks. If you finish it in four days, I will know you are applying too much.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: I will watch her, doctor. She is very generous with everything, salt, ghee, ointment.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Divya! Doctor, actually, now I remember how it started. Two Sankranthis back, I made ariselu and sakinalu for the whole street, for almost one week, rice flour, jaggery, oil, all with hands. After that only the cracks started.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: That fits completely. Days of continuous wet work, flour, sugar, oil, then the barrier breaks, and after that every small irritation keeps it going. This Sankranthi, if you are making sweets, gloves again, and take breaks.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: And Bathukamma, doctor? Every year I arrange the flowers, tangedu, gunuka, chamanthi, for hours.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Some flowers, especially chamanthi, the chrysanthemum, can cause allergy on the hands in some people. Did you notice it gets worse after Bathukamma?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Now that you say, yes, in October it was very bad. I thought it is because of the festival cooking.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Could be both. The patch test may tell us. Till then, for flower arranging also, wear the cotton and rubber gloves, or let Divya do the arrangement this time.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: I will do it, I like doing Bathukamma.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor, the cracks on the finger tips are very painful when I cook. My neighbour's son told me to put Fevikwik, the glue, to close the crack. Can I?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Please no Fevikwik. That is an industrial glue, it can irritate and cause allergy on top of the eczema. There are medical skin glues, but you don't need them. With the ointment and the moisturiser, these cracks will close in about one week. If one is very painful while cooking, cover it with a small plaster under the glove.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, no glue. Plaster under the glove.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: And look at the cracks every day. If any crack becomes red, swollen, with pus, or you get fever, don't wait for the next visit. Call the clinic and come immediately.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay doctor. Divya will call.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor, sorry, one question about me. Exams are coming and I am also getting itching on my neck when I am stressed. Is that eczema?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Could be many things, Divya. Show it to me when you come for your own appointment, along with the pimples. I don't want to guess without examining. Okay?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Okay doctor, I will book.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor, one more doubt, about thyroid. I have put on weight after thyroid, ten kilos in five years. Is that also from thyroid?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Partly it can be, if the dose is not correct. That's why we will check the TSH. Take the Thyronorm on an empty stomach, half an hour before tea, and don't take it with milk or with calcium tablets. Your physician can adjust the dose with the report.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take it with tea, doctor. Every day with the first tea.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: That is why the TSH may be off. Take it with plain water, wait half an hour, then tea. Small change, big difference.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay doctor. With water, then tea.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor, she also washes clothes by hand. We have a washing machine but she says it doesn't clean the collars.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Lakshmi garu, washing powder is one of the worst things for your hands. Please use the machine. Collars can wait, hands cannot. If you must, gloves again.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Everything gloves, doctor. I will become a surgeon.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Ha, a surgeon of pulihora. Okay, now you are relaxed, sitting for a long time. Let me check your BP once more. Give me the same arm.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Is it high still?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Now BP is one thirty two over eighty four. Much better than before. So the first reading of one forty six over ninety two was because of the rush and the stairs. This one, one thirty two over eighty four, I will record. But it is on the higher side of normal, so get it checked once a month with your physician, and reduce salt in your own food.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay doctor, less salt. Pickles also?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Pickles, papad, less. Not zero, less.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay. Now what is this test on the back you said?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: It is called a patch test. Because of your earring problem and because the hands are not fully explained by irritation alone, I want to check if you are allergic to something specific. Like nickel, or some chemical in rubber, or fragrance, or the henna chemical. We stick small patches with these substances on your back on day one, you come back after two days, we remove them and read, and then one more reading after another day or two.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Three visits? From Nalgonda?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: I know it is difficult. You can stay with relatives in Hyderabad for those few days, if possible. Monday we apply, Wednesday we read, Friday we read again. During those days don't take bath on the back and don't sweat too much. And this is important, the patch test is planned for your next visit, after two weeks, when your hands are a little settled.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Our aunty is in Dilsukhnagar, we can stay there.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Very good. Also, before that visit, get some blood tests done. H B A one C and fasting blood sugar, because your mother is diabetic and you have never checked, and diabetes makes skin healing slow. And TSH, for the thyroid.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: H B A one C, fasting sugar, TSH. Fasting means no breakfast?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: No breakfast, no tea, only water, in the morning. And the Thyronorm, take it after the blood sample is given that day.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: We can do the tests in Nalgonda itself?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Yes, any good lab is fine. Bring the reports when you come.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Okay, let me summarise everything once. Divya, check what you wrote. Stop Betnovate N, stop Candid B, stop Avil, stop all home remedies. One, clobetasol ointment on palms and cracked fingers, twice daily for two weeks. Two, Moisturex soft cream on both hands after every wash, many times a day. Three, Teczine five milligram, one tablet at bedtime for two weeks. Four, Fucidin cream only on the infected right index finger, twice daily for five days. Five, Logifeel IMF cream at bedtime on the thick areas of the palms for four weeks, with cotton gloves at night.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Yes doctor, I have all five written. Clobetasol, Moisturex, Teczine, Fucidin, Logifeel.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Rubber gloves with cotton inside for all wet work and for cutting onions and garlic. One month no vessel washing. Use the washing machine. Lukewarm water, mild cleanser. Natural henna only, only on the back of the hand, only after healing.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Got it doctor. Thank you so much, you explained so nicely. That doctor in Nalgonda saw me for two minutes only.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: You are welcome. One last thing, the plan for next time. Come back after two weeks with the blood reports, on a Monday, so we can start the patch test the same day and review the hands.
